purpose: Independent runtime verification that the artifacts Genesis's worker produced actually function correctly. The harness's own verify() checks file existence + content presence (not runtime correctness). This independent check reconstructs the artifacts and RUNS them with Node.js to confirm they execute correctly.

method.approach: Reconstruct wordfreq.mjs from the G5-08 Greenfield mission definition, then run a separate verify.mjs that imports the module and exercises tokenize(), countWords(), topN(), run(), plus a CLI invocation.

checks.label: topN-sort-by-freq-then-alpha
checks.description: topN returns entries sorted by freq desc then alphabetically

checks.label: run-end-to-end-file-in-file-out
checks.description: run(in, out, 2) writes 'apple 3\nbanana 2' for known input

checks.label: cli-invocation-different-input
checks.description: CLI invocation on 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the dog runs' produces 'the 3\ndog 2'

result.interpretation: The artifacts Genesis's worker produced (wordfreq.mjs + test.mjs) actually run and produce correct output. The verification is not just file-existence — it is runtime correctness on a known input.

reproducibility.expectedOutput:
INDEPENDENT_GREENFIELD_VERIFICATION = PASS
all artifacts function correctly; no false success
